LESSON: SELECTED CROP MANAGEMENT PRACTISES

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: AGRICULTURE
Strand: Food Production Processes
Topic 2.2: Selected Crop Management Practises

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Selected Crop Management Practises
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: How can we carry out management practises in crop production?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. explain management practises carried out on crops

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Selected Crop Management Practises

Teach
• Observe Selected Crop Management Practises in real life (school compound, home, farm).
• Use safe examples only.
• Name → explain → apply.

Worked example
• Fact 1 about Selected Crop Management Practises (in pupil words).
• Fact 2 with a Kenyan example.
• Safe action connected to Selected Crop Management Practises.

Try this
• Draw/label one diagram for Selected Crop Management Practises.
• Write 5 bullet facts about Selected Crop Management Practises.
• Say one safety rule.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• explain management practises carried out on crops

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. List 8 facts on Selected Crop Management Practises.
2. Teach a friend using only bullet points.

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Revision sheet for Selected Crop Management Practises: meaning, diagram, 5 practice questions.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How can we carry out management practises in crop production?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• explain management practises carried out on crops

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Classroom study notes (Strategy 2)
